the total potential of biomass in Jordan for power and heat generation and biogases production is 847.39GWh and 313.14MCM, respectively, where municipal solid waste generated at the middle of Jordan has the largest potential at 24.3%.

the total potential of the wastes and residues for power and biogas generation in Jordan is 847.39 GW h/yr and 313.14 MMCM/yr respectively, which could replace 23.64 % of the natural gas consumption in the year 2009.

the development of a methodology to estimate the energy potential of wastes and biomass resources in Jordan.
the assessment and analysis of biomass potential in Jordan, and its conversion into energy.
the potential utilization of biomass resources in Jordan to produce biogas and electricity.

Jordan is a promising country for the development of wastes based renewable energy.

biomass resources in Jordan are abundant and can be used to generate renewable energy and biogas, and hence, they are a good option for Jordan to diversify its energy mix.

the potential of wastes and biomass materials in Jordan is promising for bioconversion into energy.

the Jordanian government should consider the potential of wastes and biomass materials for energy generation and the development of biogas production plants.
